meta_description: Reach the Huntz team. Questions about accountability challenges, the waitlist, privacy, or partnerships: team@huntz.ai. Based in Oakland, California.

blocks.text: Huntz is small enough that your email reaches the people building it. Whatever the question, one address covers it: team@huntz.ai is read by the team, not a ticket queue.

items: Questions about how Hunts work: read {a:/how-it-works|how Huntz works} and {a:/faq|the FAQ} first, then email anything they left open.
Privacy requests: rights and processes are described in the {a:/privacy|privacy policy}; email us to exercise them.
Press, partnerships, and creators who want to run challenges: say who you are and what you have in mind.
Problems with the waitlist or this website: tell us what broke and on what device.

blocks.text: Huntz, Inc. is based at 269 24th Street, Oakland, California 94612, United States.
